title: Third school attack in Poland in a week sparks safety concerns
summary_full: Three school attacks recently occurred in Poland, resulting in injuries to multiple individuals. The first attack involved a 19-year-old student injuring nine people at a vocational school. A second incident by a 15-year-old resulted in the death of a custodian and injuries to others. Authorities responded by tightening security measures across various schools and detaining several individuals for potential threats.
